sentences.en: The ownership of the farm could be transferred to Ziri.
sentences.zh: 那片农场的所有权可以转让给Ziri。

sentences.en: Management of a company is different from ownership of a company.
sentences.zh: 公司的管理与公司所有权是不同的。

sentences.en: They disputed the ownership of the land for years.
sentences.zh: 他们多年来一直在争论土地的所有权。
